reviewType: Independent full translation review against accepted Russian, not author self-review
scopeLimit: Read the complete publication JSON in all three languages, including metadata, source notes, limitations and illustration text. Translation fidelity reviewed against accepted RU; no new claim of separately reading every historical source.

resolvedIssues.issue: 稻草 narrowed generic Russian straw to rice straw.
resolvedIssues.resolution: Author changed it to 秸秆; all ten corrected ZH records were read in full again.

findings: All ten EN and ten ZH definitions read completely. Scope arrays, slugs and every source URL match accepted RU; no additional dates, numerical claims or unsupported historical episodes were introduced.

EN is natural and preserves maritime and fortification senses. Casemate and indemnity identify their additional Russian senses explicitly rather than attributing them indiscriminately to English terms.
ZH is readable and uses appropriate naval/fortification words: 锚地, 榴霰弹, 胸墙, 掩蔽部. The fanza roof description no longer invents a crop.

EN pennant-count alias66vessels and fanza aliashouses were checked in final-matcher-audit-en.json actual contexts. These attach a contextual explanation without changing the existing translated article. Their assigned pages remain restricted.

Internment excludes ships from combat without retroactively applying1907/1949conventions; concession does not transfer ownership of land. Conditional house construction and print-process explanation retain their original limits.
No unresolved translation issues. Author of Russian definitions is the reviewer here, but EN and ZH were authored by other agents; this is not acceptance of the reviewer’s own translation.
